info.name: Rental Property - Auth Service | Automated API Regression
info.description: 57 ordered API test cases grounded in feature/auth-service. Run against an isolated local MySQL auth_db through http://localhost:8081. Must run in the listed order. Creates unique CUSTOMER and STAFF per run; never changes or locks OWNER. See README for configuration and limitations.
